fertilizers.name: Neem Coated Urea (N 46%)
fertilizers.dosage: 110-130 kg/acre split into 3 doses (Basal, Tillering, Panicle)

fertilizers.name: DAP (18:46:0)
fertilizers.dosage: 50 kg/acre as basal dose at last puddling

rice.organic: Sesbania / Dhaincha green manuring (50-60 days before puddling) or 5 tons FYM/acre.
rice.irrigation_advisory: Standing water of 2-5 cm during tillering & flowering stages.

fertilizers.name: Urea
fertilizers.dosage: 100 kg/acre (1/3 basal, 1/3 knee-high stage, 1/3 tasseling stage)

maize.organic: FYM 4-5 tonnes/acre before sowing + Azotobacter seed treatment.
maize.irrigation_advisory: Critical stages: knee-high, tasseling, and grain filling.

fertilizers.name: DAP
fertilizers.dosage: 40-50 kg/acre at sowing (provides starter N & essential P)

chickpea.organic: Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg seed for wilt protection; 3 tonnes compost/acre.
chickpea.irrigation_advisory: Needs dry climate with 1-2 light irrigations (pre-flowering and pod development).

kidneybeans.npk_standard: 90-120:60:40 kg/ha (Weak nodulator, requires higher N than other pulses)
kidneybeans.organic: Well-decomposed vermicompost @ 2 tonnes/acre + PSB (Phosphorus Solubilizing Bacteria).
kidneybeans.irrigation_advisory: Sensitive to waterlogging. Ensure well-drained loamy soil.

pigeonpeas.organic: Rhizobium + PSB seed coating + 4 tonnes FYM.
pigeonpeas.irrigation_advisory: Deep taproot system; drought tolerant; 1 irrigation at pod development if rain fails.

mothbeans.organic: Extremely drought hardy. Farmyard manure 2 tonnes/acre.
mothbeans.irrigation_advisory: Thrives in low rainfall (300-500mm); avoid waterlogging.

mungbean.irrigation_advisory: 3-4 light irrigations for summer crop, avoiding during peak flowering.

blackgram.irrigation_advisory: Critical at branching and pod filling stages.

lentil.irrigation_advisory: Needs 1-2 irrigations at 40-45 days and pod initiation.

fertilizers.name: Urea
fertilizers.dosage: 500g per mature plant in 3 split doses

pomegranate.organic: FYM 20-25 kg per plant + Neem cake 2 kg per plant annually.
pomegranate.irrigation_advisory: Drip irrigation 20-30 liters/tree alternate days during fruiting.

fertilizers.name: MOP (Potash)
fertilizers.dosage: 500g per plant in 4 splits (essential for bunch weight)

banana.organic: FYM 10 kg/plant + Panchagavya foliar spray (3%) monthly.
banana.irrigation_advisory: High water requirement (drip 15-25 L/day/plant). Keep soil moist.

fertilizers.name: Urea
fertilizers.dosage: 1 kg per mature tree in July and October

mango.organic: 50 kg FYM + 2 kg Bone meal per tree in monsoon basin application.
mango.irrigation_advisory: Stop irrigation 2 months prior to flowering; resume during marble stage.

grapes.irrigation_advisory: Drip fertigation precisely scheduled; reduce water near harvest for sugar brix.

watermelon.irrigation_advisory: Light frequent irrigation on drip with plastic mulch; stop 5 days before harvest.

muskmelon.organic: FYM 4 tonnes/acre in furrows + Neem cake 150 kg/acre.
muskmelon.irrigation_advisory: Channel or drip irrigation; keep vine beds dry.

fertilizers.name: Boric Acid / Zinc spray
fertilizers.dosage: Foliar spray at pink bud stage

apple.organic: FYM 40-50 kg/tree in winter basin dressing + pine needle mulching.
apple.irrigation_advisory: Requires 1000-1200 chilling hours; drip irrigation during fruit expansion.

fertilizers.name: Urea
fertilizers.dosage: 1.2 kg/tree in 3 equal parts (Jan, May, Aug)

orange.organic: FYM 25 kg/tree + Trichoderma harzianum soil drenching for root rot protection.
orange.irrigation_advisory: Ring basin or drip method; avoid direct trunk contact with water.

papaya.organic: Neem cake 1 kg/plant + Vermicompost 5 kg/plant at planting.
papaya.irrigation_advisory: Highly sensitive to water stagnation (causes collar rot). Use raised beds.

fertilizers.name: MOP
fertilizers.dosage: 2 kg/palm (critical for nut size and copra yield)

coconut.organic: 50 kg green leaf / compost + Coir pith mulching in palm basin.
coconut.irrigation_advisory: Drip 30-40 L/palm/day; mulching around 2m radius to conserve moisture.

fertilizers.name: Urea
fertilizers.dosage: 90-100 kg/acre in 3 splits (sowing, square, peak boll)

fertilizers.name: Magnesium Sulphate
fertilizers.dosage: 10 kg/acre to prevent red leaf disease

cotton.irrigation_advisory: 4-5 irrigations; avoid water stress during flowering and boll development.

fertilizers.name: Urea
fertilizers.dosage: 50 kg/acre in 2 splits (basal & 3 weeks after sowing)

jute.irrigation_advisory: Requires high rainfall (150-250cm) and high humidity (70-90%).

coffee.organic: Coffee pulp compost 3 tonnes/acre + Shade tree leaf litter.
coffee.irrigation_advisory: Blossom shower irrigation in March-April (25-30mm) followed by backing shower.
